tier_should.rationale: Novel, policy-relevant quantification of urban greening’s PM2.5 benefits versus pollen costs using remote sensing, wind-based identification, and claims data. Large program and plausible design; ozone ambiguity remains. With cleaner exposition, merits upper field.

tier_will.rationale: Strong topic and data, but uneven writing and under-described methods weaken credibility. Fit best with environmental/urban field journals; acceptance depends on clearer identification and robustness checks rather than general-interest or top-field outlets.
